Customer service experience with a friendly, professional, and accommodating approach.
Experience working in a healthcare, medical office, or student health setting.
Experience performing administrative, clerical, or front office functions in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with electronic medical records and computerized appointment scheduling systems.
Experience supporting patient flow and coordinating with clinical staff.
Schedule patient appointments for General Medical, Specialty, and Nurse Clinics using the computerized scheduling system.
Perform front office reception duties, including greeting patients, answering phones, and facilitating patient flow.
Maintain and update electronic medical records and complete related administrative and clerical functions.
Collaborate with nursing staff and healthcare providers to support daily clinic operations and patient care.
Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements and established health and safety procedures.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with patients, staff, and healthcare providers.
Familiarity with medical terminology and healthcare administrative procedures.
Ability to accurately handle confidential information and maintain patient privacy in accordance with HIPAA.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
